messages:
emily: heads-up: noticed a spike of duplicate rows in agg.hourly for US-west between 2026-03-18T06:00 and 2026-03-18T12:00. looks like a consumer offset reset + replays from connector. duplicates are creating inflated counts on product dashboards.

alex: ouch. can we do a targeted dedupe-recompute for that 6h window? full backfill would be heavy.

li: quick query shows ~17 tenants hit, duplicate_count ~ 18k rows overall. example query: 
```
SELECT tenant_id, count(*) as rows, count(distinct event_id) as unique_events
FROM raw.events
WHERE timestamp >= '2026-03-18T06:00:00Z' AND timestamp < '2026-03-18T12:00:00Z'
GROUP BY tenant_id;
```

maria: console currently only supports --day granularity. we need a window/range flag for reprocess to avoid touching unrelated hours. also need an idempotency/dedupe mode in the replayer.

devon: replayer already supports event_id dedupe when invoked with --dedupe=true, but console doesn't expose it. small API lift to add --range and --dedupe to the UI/CLI. can do a staged rollout.

jordan: we should also show an "expected net delta" panel before running so PMs know whether numbers will drop. add recompute.expected_duplicates and recompute.estimated_cost metrics.

ops: reminder: US-west concurrency cap is 6 slots by default. we can raise to 10 for a short canary if needed but need approval. also watch S3 egress if you pull raw events.

emily: propose plan:
1) devon adds --range + --dedupe UI/CLI flags to staging (minimal change).
2) li produces tenant list and sample event_id list for top 3 tenants.
3) run dry-run with --dedupe --dry-run to estimate unique_events vs rows.
4) show preflight deltas in console (new tile: recompute.dedupe_preview).
5) canary recompute for 3 tenants with ops slot bump to 10 and dedupe enabled.
6) if delta confirms and errors < 0.2%, proceed batched recompute with concurrency=4. auto-skip any tenant hitting malformed events.

maria: add tagging: telemetry:dedupe and alert if post-run delta% > 5 for any tenant (to catch regressions). capture pre/post schema version tags too.

devon: timeline: I can push the flag to staging in the next 3 hours (branch: console/reprocess-range). deploy will be canaried. rollback = remove flag.

li: uploaded tenant list to drive: https://redwood-internal/drive/recompute/usw-20260318-tenants.csv (17 tenants). sample event ids for tenant_77 posted to gist.

jordan: for dry-run please emit metrics: recompute.estimated_unique and recompute.estimated_tokens; also recompute.sky_unexpected_schema boolean if event schema mismatches known version. we'll show that on the tile.

ops: I'll pre-approve slot bump for canary (to 10) once dry-run metrics are posted. please include run_id in the ping.

emily: dry-run command example: 
```
reprocess-cli --range 2026-03-18T06:00:00Z/2026-03-18T12:00:00Z \
  --tenants-file s3://recompute/usw-20260318-tenants.csv --kind hourly \
  --dedupe --dry-run --output metrics://recompute/dedupe-preview/1746601111
```

sre-bot: [deploy] triggered: devon/console/reprocess-range -> staging (ci/2478). link: https://ci.internal/2478 :rocket:

maria: add a preflight check for connector health: abort if connector.replay_rate > 10 events/s for the window or kafka.lag is growing. we don't want concurrent replays fighting this run.

devon: will add kafka-lag and connector-rate guard. also will surface estimated slot usage per-tenant to console so sched can plan.

emily: canaries: tenant_77, tenant_300, tenant_109. owners tagged in the run meta. ops please bump when I post run_id.

li: dry-run results posted: metrics link recompute/dedupe-preview/1746601111 026k duplicates expected to be removed, unique_events ~ 240k, token cost est ~4.5M.

jordan: dashboard tile created and alert wired: if any tenant delta% > 5 or errors > 0.2% during canary -> auto-stop and notify #incidents.

ops: slot bump scheduled. ping @ops when you kick off canary and include run_id. I'll monitor and revert if S3/egraph costs spike.

emily: kicking off canary in ~15m. will post run_id and metrics. thanks all.
